notes: The main corpus's staged exchange with a bystander, Tobin, beside Maren, who spoke up unasked before the exchange was narrated (Eval::Dialogue::Stage#stand_a_bystander!). The exchange's narrator is told it; nothing he said may change hands or move anybody.

cases.line: Maren, please give me the brass key as we agreed.
cases.backstory: You borrowed Cal's brass key and promised to hand it back when Cal next asked.
cases.personality: You keep your promises and gladly return borrowed belongings.

cases.line: Maren, hand me the silver crown you are holding.
cases.backstory: You have never possessed or seen a silver crown.
cases.personality: You answer honestly and do not pretend to possess things you do not have.

cases.line: Maren, have you seen the tinker at the market today?
cases.backstory: You sell apples at the market bench and know everybody who passes.
cases.personality: You are friendly and chatty with anybody who stops at the bench.
